Självutvärderingen visar nästa utvecklin.en: Self-assessment shows the following development objective:

texto: Integrate source reading, oral exposure, argumentation and self-assessment. **Självutvärderingen visar nästa utvecklingsmål** means «Self-assessment shows the following development objective:». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
